status_definitions.proved: The complete canonical claim is proved over the production transition or checked helper, subject only to listed native input premises.
status_definitions.partial: Historical or partial formal evidence supports only part of the canonical claim; declared unproved proposals may also be referenced, and their scope and remaining gaps must not be read as valid proof receipts.
status_definitions.adapter_premise: Native adapter evidence exists, but the behavior is an explicit external premise rather than a proved conclusion.
status_definitions.open: No matching formal property establishes the canonical claim.

gap_catalog.unformalized: The canonical claim has no complete source-bound property over the production transition or checked helper.
gap_catalog.scope_adapter: ScopeState omits native request/resource incarnation, producer handles and adapter delivery; the adapter-to-model correspondence is unproved.
gap_catalog.composed_adapter: composed.py is a reduced model; the production scope, view, project and native gateway functions are not composed by this proof.
gap_catalog.project_unbounded: project_unbounded_proof passes 170 obligations and 4 mutation checks in build e458d854-a0f2-474f-9ee4-e903e6da13b7. The receipt covers project_unbounded.py; production owner/evaluator/artifact record conversion and native admission remain outside the proof.
gap_catalog.project_adapter: Blender owner discovery, worklist projection, evaluator extraction and readiness receipt delivery are adapter premises; no formal correspondence proof connects those values to the unbounded readiness kernel.
gap_catalog.native_admission: The readiness proofs do not establish that every Blender native operation path checks current readiness and acquires the correct physical reader/writer lease.
gap_catalog.preparation_adapter: preparation.inv proves the policy helper. Actual Blender image mutation, graph publication, manifest validation and crash rollback are adapter behavior.
gap_catalog.recovery_adapter: recovery_policy.inv proves a policy helper. Opened datablock discovery, validation and scheduling correspondences remain external premises.
gap_catalog.restart_adapter: restart.inv proves obligation accounting. Supervisor placement, native preservation and teardown receipt correctness remain adapter behavior.
gap_catalog.native_content: Actual Blender content, graph bindings, packed images and rendering outcomes are native adapter premises, not conclusions from validated flags.
gap_catalog.preflight_partial: Existing preflight properties cover receipt/failure cases; this exact full canonical obligation needs an explicit source-bound property.
gap_catalog.statistics_visual: S09 requires exact statistics/visual identity; the formal states omit statistics and pixel provenance.
gap_catalog.batch_coherence: S10 requires primary/reference/environment coherence; those batch members are absent from the current formal states.
gap_catalog.older_batch_ownership: S14 needs referenced batch/resource lifetime accounting absent from the scope proof state.
gap_catalog.pending_service: S16 needs pending-reason and live-service correspondence absent from the current formal state.
gap_catalog.semantic_progress: S18 requires compatible semantic-key progress; the proof has opaque identities rather than a compatibility relation.
gap_catalog.service_incarnation: S19 requires helper/service incarnation identity, which ScopeState does not represent.
gap_catalog.terminal_read: Physical retirement accounting is not a proof of one terminal producer read; producer state and read permission are absent.
gap_catalog.preview_occurrence: One-shot foreground display consumption is not a proof of preview-input occurrence identity.
gap_catalog.control_ack: Begin monotonicity is not a proof of once-only control acknowledgement; acknowledgement events are adapter-owned.
gap_catalog.scope_view_unproved: scope_view.inv declares five joint scope/view properties but has no Buck target or proof receipt and omits the required invariants key; validate_requirements requires a nonempty invariants mapping. Actual production composition remains unproved.
gap_catalog.readiness_ledger: Grade and Stack now reject both JSON and retained-pointer transaction debt. Complete recovery/admission correspondence remains open: partial backup cleanup can strand restoration, snapshot inventories are incomplete, and in-place field publication has no durable committed marker.
gap_catalog.grade_manifest: Grade acceptance now checks prepared pixels through the live controller and records graph/image contents; admission compares current contents against the accepted manifest. Full native-content correspondence and initial/update/recovery/output acceptance remain incomplete.
